source.notes: Native resolver stack identifies AutocompleteWrapper, ApplicationCommandDiscovery or ApplicationCommandsCategories; see manifest runtimeConsumerStacks.

privacy.notes: Full frames inspected: fictional command descriptions, names and channel; generic app and user avatars.

visual.notes: Full frames and original-scale comparison inspected. Partial third command is the native scroll viewport boundary. Baseline and restoration are pixel identical.

annotation.notes: Thin outline identifies the measured affected surface or panel border without covering content.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Changes confined to the intended panel area. Translucent category icons naturally composite over its background. Chat and composer unchanged.

description.notes: Colours the command suggestion panel background.
